name: Node.js backend
description: Server-side TypeScript or JavaScript on the Node.js runtime.
architecture: Keep transport handlers thin; put decisions in testable modules.
Make side effects explicit at the edge of the process.
structure: One entry point per deployable process.
Configuration is read once at startup.
conventions: Use the language's module system consistently; do not mix module formats in one package.
security: Pin the runtime major version and record it in the configuration.
Never read secrets from tracked files.
documentation: Document run, build, and test commands in the README.
tooling: A formatter and linter in CI.

compatibility.notes: Applies to services, CLIs, and libraries that run on Node.js.
